_role: Evolve proposed adapter representation — NOT canonical REVAS input. REVAS should independently ingest control_atom.json + live_state.json as the canonical Evolve-side source and produce revas_representation.json independently. This file represents Evolve's proposed mapping and should be compared against the independent REVAS representation to identify semantic drift at the translation boundary.

request._state_boundary_note: candidate is the state when the request object was created (12:00:00Z). pending_dual_authorization is the evaluation state at 12:00:05Z. These are distinct — see case.json state_transitions.

verification_state._note: Authority state is preserved at the individual check level — not collapsed into a single boolean.

expected_behavior.verify: incomplete — primary authority verified, secondary pending, authorization event not yet logged
expected_behavior._hold_semantics: Temporarily incomplete / still satisfiable. Not REJECT — authority window is open and conditions can still be met.
expected_behavior.reason: sensitive_category == true triggers dual authorization requirement under organizational policy built on PHI_ACCESS_001 control atom

artifact.receipt_format: TrustLedger SHA-256 anchored receipt on adoption
artifact.rollback_scope: All downstream EHR states derived from this recommendation must be reverified if authorization is invalidated
